GigaCloud Marketplace offers a seamless end-to-end experience that includes discovery, payments, and logistics solutions on a user-friendly platform. Our global reach connects suppliers and resellers from around the world, fostering a cohesive ecosystem that enables businesses to grow and thrive. By facilitating cross-border transactions with confidence, speed, and efficiency, we empower Marketplace users to create endless opportunities and explore new businesses.

Distributors, brands, and suppliers unlock new growth opportunities by connecting with thousands of global resellers through our dynamic Marketplace community—expanding their reach while driving meaningful impact to both top- and bottom-line performance.

Retailers and resellers can efficiently source quality products from a diverse network of global sellers, leveraging our streamlined Marketplace to reduce inventory risk, optimize costs, and simplify supply chain management.

raw_blocks: GIGACLOUD TECHNOLOGY IS AN ONLINE GLOBAL B2B SOLUTIONS PROVIDER THAT IS REINVENTING THE SUPPLY CHAIN FOR WHOLESALE BUYERS AND SELLERS OF LARGE PARCEL MERCHANDISE
GigaCloud Technology is an online global B2B solutions provider that is reinventing the supply chain for wholesale buyers and sellers of large-parcel merchandise.
Our GigaCloud B2B Marketplace seamlessly connects suppliers and resellers across the globe in real time.

The GigaCloud B2B Marketplace is transforming the wholesale supply chain for big and bulky merchandise, seamlessly connecting suppliers and resellers worldwide. Our end-to-end platform integrates product discovery, transactions, and fulfillment, backed by a global logistics network across the U.S., U.K., Germany, Canada, and Japan. With thousands of SKUs and proprietary technology for real-time market insights, our Marketplace simplifies sourcing, selling, and shipping—creating a more efficient, connected global supply chain.

GigaCloud enhances trust between buyers and sellers by creating a more reliable transaction environment. It offers better opportunities and support by providing access to historical data on the performance of other parties in the marketplace. The Giga Index is an automatic scoring system that assesses the Seller's service level and the Buyer's purchasing power in the GigaCloud B2B Marketplace.
